summary: The diff implements a single-page marketing layout with the requested major sections (Hero, About, Menu Highlights, Why People Love It, Reviews, Visit Us, Footer), smooth-scroll for “View Menu”, an “Order Online” user-triggered dialog, and card-based menu highlights using static asset paths with alt text and lazy-loading. However, some required business info is not shown on the page, the phone link format does not match the specified tel:(781) 990-3282 requirement, the footer does not include the requested logo, and Internet Identity/auth plumbing is actively wired despite the constraint that it remain unused unless requested.

missing_requirements.requirement: All provided business information strings (including price range and service options) must appear exactly as provided.
missing_requirements.reason: The page components shown render address/phone/hours/rating, but there is no display of price range ($1–10 per person) or service options (Dine-in, Takeout).

missing_requirements.requirement: Footer must include name/logo, address, phone, hours, and social icons.
missing_requirements.reason: Footer shows the business name as text plus address/phone/hours and an Instagram icon, but no logo image is rendered in the footer.

missing_requirements.requirement: Visit Us section must include a clickable phone link using tel:(781) 990-3282.
missing_requirements.reason: The implementation uses phoneLink "tel:+17819903282" rather than the specified tel:(781) 990-3282 format.

hallucinated_features.description: Internet Identity is actively wired into the app (provider mounted; actor hook depends on identity), despite the constraint that Internet Identity hooks remain unused unless explicitly requested.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest explicitly says Internet Identity hooks remain unused unless requested later, but main.tsx wraps the app with InternetIdentityProvider and a useActor hook is present using useInternetIdentity.

hallucinated_features.description: Hardcoded Google Maps Embed API key in the Visit Us map iframe URL.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest asked for an embedded map but did not request embedding via an API key or adding a specific key in source.
Not requested in requirements (footer requirements were name/logo, address, phone, hours, social icons).
